section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the test adaptation of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) from English to Malay following a five-stage translation procedure. A pre-test sample of 40 individuals (60% women) who were fluent in Malay rated items for understanding on a 5-point scale (overall M = 3.98, SD = 0.46), and minor grammatical adjustments were made to four items to improve clarity while maintaining semantic equivalence. The final translated version was used in the present study.
section_summary.evidence_source: Section 2.3 'Test adaptation' describing the BAS-2 translation methodology and pre-test validation.
